exam_context: IBPS PO Prelims 2026 (CRP PO/MT-XVI) — first stage of the three-stage selection process (Prelims, Mains, Interview) for Probationary Officer/Management Trainee posts at participating public-sector banks in India.
data_provenance: Estimated from IBPS's CRP PO/MT notification pattern as reported by multiple 2025-2026 coaching/exam-tracker sources (Oliveboard, Adda247, PracticeMock, Testbook, BankBazaar, Sreedhar's CCE), cross-checked Sep 2026. The section-wise marks split used here (English 30 / Quant 35 / Reasoning 35) is the classic, most consistently corroborated pattern and matches your reference bank. A minority of Sep 2026 sources report a 'revised' CRP PO/MT-XVI split (Reasoning 40 / Quant 30, English unchanged at 30) — flagged here as unconfirmed; verify against the official notification at ibps.in before relying on either split for a live cycle.

marking_scheme.source_note: Confirmed via multiple Sep 2026 sources describing the IBPS PO Prelims marking pattern; unchanged across recent CRP PO/MT cycles.
marking_scheme.qualifying_nature: Prelims marks do NOT count toward final merit/selection. Prelims is purely a qualifying round — candidates must clear both the sectional and the overall cut-off to be shortlisted for Mains; final ranking is based on Mains + Interview scores only.
marking_scheme.sectional_cutoffs: Yes — candidates must clear the minimum qualifying marks in EACH of the three sections (English, Quant, Reasoning) individually, in addition to the overall cut-off.
marking_scheme.question_types_used: Single-correct 5-option MCQ only. No numerical-value, multiple-correct, or descriptive questions in Prelims (a Descriptive Test exists only at the Mains stage).

exam_logistics.sectional_timing: Strict independent sectional timing — 20 minutes per section, no switching between sections and no carrying over unused time from one section to another
exam_logistics.medium_of_exam: English and Hindi (except the English Language section itself, which is tested only in English)
exam_logistics.final_merit_weighting_note: Final selection merit is based on normalized Mains score plus Interview score; Prelims performance itself is not carried forward into the merit calculation.

downstream_stage_context.note: Included for reference only — these stages are NOT part of the Prelims exam being seeded here.
